decisions.reason: Particle therapy water phantoms serve a small, growing niche with long adoption cycles, so the option is still uncertain and cheap to carry, though the drop from a dedicated page to a mention in 2019 is a mild warning sign.
Small volume chambers are core dosimetry consumables with steady demand from small-field and SRS QA, and their carrying cost is low.
The product kept its dedicated page and fits the firm's core chamber portfolio, so dropping it gains little.
A standard clinical chamber line with several models is a staple of the established business and is unlikely to be withdrawn.
Relative dosimetry chambers pair with the firm's water phantom systems and cost little to maintain.
Thimble chambers are basic, long-lived catalog items with ongoing calibration and service revenue.
